scripts.check: npm test && node scripts/validate-site.mjs && npm run worker:check
scripts.worker:check: node --check worker/src/index.js && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .tmp/wrangler-dry-run
scripts.feedback:db:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply bytlot-feedback --local --config worker/wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.feedback:dev: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --local --assets . --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --config worker/wrangler.local.jsonc --log-level warn --show-interactive-dev-session false
